character: A square, weathered human woman of about fifty, close-cropped iron-grey hair. A brass prosthetic left hand. A flat, unimpressed mouth, appraising eyes.
wardrobe: A practical dark coat with brass buttons, a quartermaster's ledger tucked under her arm.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing straight, brass hand resting on a railing.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: On a high deck at night overlooking a city made of ships stacked on ships, lanterns everywhere below her.
